newsitem.title: USA: High Plains Wheat - Interior bids firm.
newsitem.headline: High Plains Wheat - Interior bids firm.

text.p: More basis bids for hard red winter wheat firmed at elevators in Kansas and Oklahoma as producers continued to refrain from selling their wheat, grain merchandisers said Thursday.

"I think there's some frustration that farmers aren't selling, and these higher bids are a sign of that," an Oklahoma dealer said. "They're looking to sell their fall crops for cash and hold on to their wheat until next year."
More rains were reported overnight in Kansas and Oklahoma, causing further delays to harvest and planting activities there.

Dealers said that although conditions had cleared by Thursday, temperatures were much cooler. Dealers in the central and western parts of the state said morning temperatures were in the 40s (degrees Fahrenheit).
There was a 60 percent chance of freezing rain or snow on Friday in Southwest Kansas, a dealer said.
Basis values in cents/bu against KCBT wheat, cash=dollars/bu.
